article.title: Notre Dame’s Hannah Hidalgo is the ACC Player of the Year
article.description: Notre Dame’s Hannah Hidalgo wins ACC Player of the Year while Cassandre Prosper also gets recognized as most improved
article.content:
ACC Womens Basketball Announces 2025-26 Award Winners
CHARLOTTE, N.C. (theACC.com)  Notre Dame junior guard Hannah Hidalgo has been chosen as the 2025-26 Atlantic Coast Conference Player of the Year… [+7991 chars]
